# Intune Gotchas

> Known Microsoft Intune / endpoint-policy patterns that cause silent failures or hard-to-debug errors.

## Entries

- [Azure VM Entra-ID RDP fails until Microsoft Remote Desktop has a tenant-wide consent grant for Azure Windows VM Sign-In](entra-vm-rdp-tenant-consent.md): Entra-joined Azure VMs by IP fail with "requested security package does not exist" / AADSTS50206 / AADSTS65002 because the Microsoft Remote Desktop -> Azure Windows VM Sign-In consent has never been granted in the tenant. The generic admin-consent URL fails on the app's legacy AAD Graph permission. Fix: targeted oauth2PermissionGrant for just the user_impersonation scope. Also names common red herrings (RCG, Lsa Security Packages, SYSTEM-context dsregcmd). HIGH.
- [Autodesk (ODIS) Win32 deploy: package the generated image, not the downloaded creator exe](autodesk-odis-win32-deploy.md): The ~30 MB Autodesk download is AdOdisDeployTool.exe (a creator), not the installer; run it to build the multi-GB image folder, then wrap that. Also: cert app-only Graph auth uploads Win32 LOB fine (content goes to the Azure SAS URI), and you need DeviceManagementApps.ReadWrite.All. HIGH.
